abstractEnglish: We prove that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with values in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive. Together with the established degree-one inner-derivation theorem, this resolves the Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture positively.
titleEn: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology
titleZh: 高阶有界Hochschild上同调的消没

details.overview: 稿件研究复von Neumann代数上取值于自身的有界Hochschild上同调。作者声称证明了次数至少为2的每个有界Hochschild余循环都有有界原语，并结合已有的次数1内导子定理，正面解决了Kadison–Ringrose上同调猜想。该结果若成立，将统一处理高阶上同调的消没问题，对算子代数上同调理论有重要意义。摘要未给出证明细节或独立验证信息。
keyPoints: 证明复von Neumann代数上次数≥2的有界Hochschild余循环均有有界原语。
结合次数1内导子定理，声称正面解决Kadison–Ringrose上同调猜想。
研究对象为取值于代数自身的有界Hochschild上同调。
